name: yunet
role: face detection, cropped from the top ~35% of a confirmed-ENTRY person box (Expansion Plan Phase F; PLAN.md section 7)
licence_verified: 2026-09-15. Read models/face_detection_yunet/LICENSE in opencv_zoo, confirmed MIT, copyright Shiqi Yu.
runtime: cv2.FaceDetectorYN (OpenCV's own wrapper) - not raw onnxruntime. The raw ONNX output is undecoded multi-scale SSD-style anchors (three detection heads x cls/obj/bbox/kps each); OpenCV's wrapper is the reference decoder for this exact export.

files.input: dynamic (setInputSize per call - a face crop's size varies per detection)
files.output: raw: cls_8/16/32, obj_8/16/32, bbox_8/16/32, kps_8/16/32 (three strides) - decoded by cv2.FaceDetectorYN into (box, 5 landmarks, score) rows
